C0850.title: Global Police Intensify Crackdown on Phishing Crimes
C0850.summary: In November 2025, facing a persistent surge in phishing scams, law enforcement agencies across multiple countries announced escalated enforcement measures. Data shows that phishing reports in Japan rose nearly 70% year-on-year in the first half of 2025.
